prompt: Build for this brief: A cultural venue; visitors browse works, plan visits and find events. Use Plum and Mint: page #FCF9FF, text #3D2346, accent #805099, secondary surface #CDF3DF, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Young Serif and reading text in Inter; rounded expressive serif heading with neutral text. Composition: Chronological entries with dates on a shared rail, compact media, explicit sequence. Use body 14px, heading 80px, line height 1.6, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 48px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
